request.style: English, slow soul, smooth male vocal with female backing singers, Rhodes piano, warm bass, muted guitar, soft horns, laid-back drums, patient and calm, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I see the man whose way prospers, every scheme he makes goes right
And the anger starts to burn in me and keeps me up at night
But the psalm is singing softly, do not burn and do not fret
Dwell in the land and do what's good, his word will hold you yet

[Chorus]
Take your delight in the LORD
And he will give you what your heart asks
Commit your way to the LORD
Trust in him, and he will act
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him

[Verse]
Like the morning breaking slowly over hills of grey and blue
He will bring your righteousness to light and let it shine for you
Like the noonday sun your justice will be plain for all to see
So I lay my worry down and let him walk ahead of me

[Chorus]
Take your delight in the LORD
And he will give you what your heart asks
Commit your way to the LORD
Trust in him, and he will act
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him

[Bridge]
Trust in the LORD and do good
Dwell in the land and make faithfulness your pasture
Be still, be still
Wait patiently for him

[Outro]
Take your delight in the LORD
Trust in him, and he will act
